ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly biased toward low-intensity (black) pixel values, with approximately 15% of the surface area occupied by high-intensity (white/light-grey) localized clusters and linear features.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast circular mottle clusters located in the mid-section of the left lobe (approx. center) and multiple overlapping circular blobs on the distal half of the right lobe. Isolated high-intensity streaks distributed across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression; vertex provides a sharp transition point with a depth-to-width ratio of approximately 1:1 within its localized region.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-amplitude peaks and valleys along the medial trailing edges of both lobes, transitioning to a more continuous, smoother boundary toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, sweeping upward toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast ring-like clusters (rosettes) visible: two distinct on the left lobe and a complex cluster of three to four overlapping rosettes on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (white rake marks) visible, particularly a cluster of diagonal streaks on the lower section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified clusters (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
